div.head: IV As 6.3
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe hine ofer þæt feormige, sy ðæs ilcan wyrðe þæs ðe se ðeof, butan he hine ladian mæge, ðæt he him nan facn ne nane ðyfþe on nyste.
⁊ se ðe hine ofer þæt feormige sy ðæs ilcan wyrðe þæs ðe se ðeof, butan he hine ladian mæge, ðæt he him nan facn ne nane ðyfþe on nyste.
And he who harbours him longer shall be liable to the same treatment as the thief unless he can clear himself, [by proving] that he was unaware of any crime or theft committed by him.
Und wer ihn danach noch beherbergt, sei desselben [Looses] theilhaftig wie dieser Dieb, es sei denn, er könne sich reinigen, dass er an ihm keinen Trug und keinen Diebstahl kannte.
And whoever harbours him after that, let him be subject to the same [fate] as the thief, unless he can clear himself [by showing] that he knew of no fraud and no theft in him.
div.note: In H, ‘Þus feor’ (Pax, Schmid's App. XII) follows after a paragraph break.
